Description

Looking for a versatile outdoor sports facility in Roehampton? The MUGA at Lifestyle Fitness Roehampton is available to hire for netball, tennis, or the full MUGA, providing a great space for individuals, clubs, schools, teams and community groups.

Whether you're looking for a casual game, regular training sessions or a larger group booking, the MUGA offers a flexible outdoor space suitable for a range of activities. Free parking is available on site, making it convenient for players and visitors.

Book your MUGA court at Lifestyle Fitness Roehampton today and get active!
